description: No saturation step is available from a finite clause set \(\Gamma\) if and only if \(\Gamma\) is closed under every applicable resolution inference.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.no_step_iff_closed.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSet α) :
  (¬∃ Δ, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Step Γ Δ) ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Closed Γ
